method: YouTube oEmbed metadata (platform-fetch tool). Direct yt-dlp/curl egress to youtube.com is firewalled in this sandbox; metadata + thumbnails were retrieved via the platform proxy. Frame/transcript extraction requires an environment with YouTube egress — scripts are in tools/video_research/.

videos.title: INFRA Act 1 100% (Full Game All Collectibles No Commentary)
videos.author: Tom Purcell
videos.why: INFRA is the single closest tonal reference: a structural analyst walks decaying industrial/water/utility infrastructure (dams, pump houses, tunnels, substations). Direct blueprint for Pump Station 7's realistic, functional, aged industrial spaces and 'inspect the facility' pacing.

videos.title: SOMA (FULL GAME)
videos.author: jacksepticeye
videos.why: PATHOS-II is an underwater research/power station — coastal-underwater facility horror done right. Reference for underwater pressure-vessel spaces, power/pump machinery, environmental storytelling, and dread through absence rather than jump scares.

videos.title: AMNESIA THE BUNKER Gameplay Walkthrough FULL GAME (4K 60FPS) No Commentary
videos.author: Shirrako
videos.why: The Bunker's core loop is a generator that must be fuelled and restarted — directly maps to Pump Station 7's fuse -> generator -> power objective. Reference for a single interconnected facility, resource/logic-driven power, and a stalker that responds to light and noise.

videos.title: SCP Containment Breach Safe Gameplay | No Commentary
videos.author: Sesawer
videos.why: Procedural corridors of a containment facility; cheap but effective dread from darkness, blinking, and a pursuer you hear before you see. Lesson for lighting + sound-driven tension on a small budget.

videos.title: BLACK MESA Full Game Walkthrough - No Commentary (#BlackMesa Full Gameplay)
videos.author: RabidRetrospectGames
videos.why: Gold standard for a believable scientific-industrial facility: signage, rail/piping, service areas, and guided-but-not-hand-held level flow. Reference for how a facility's architecture itself teaches the player where to go.

videos.title: Portal 2 Full Game (No Commentary) With Extended/hidden Dialogue
videos.author: BadShoesGames
videos.why: Aperture Science: an abandoned research facility told entirely through environment (faded signage, overgrown chambers, office layers). Reference for environmental storytelling and mixing clean/lived-in/ruined zones within one facility.

videos.title: OUTLAST 2 | Full Game Movie | NIGHTMARE Difficulty Walkthrough Gameplay 4K 60FPS ULTRA No Commentary
videos.author: HGH Horror Games House
videos.why: Pursuit/chase horror and camcorder-night-vision framing. Lesson (and caution): relentless chase loops exhaust players; Pump Station 7 should use restraint — tension mostly from the space, chases only at story peaks.

videos.title: Outlast First five minutes of gameplay (No commentary)
videos.author: Shadowy Mist
videos.why: The asylum's opening: how to build anticipation in the first five minutes (normal entry -> wrongness -> flight). Useful for pacing the arrival at Pump Station 7's reception.

videos.title: Alien Isolation Walkthrough Part 1 [1080p HD PC ULTRA] Alien Isolation Gameplay - No Commentary
videos.author: MKIceAndFire
videos.why: Sevastopol Station: industrial corridors, vents, and a single unscripted stalker. Reference for sightline manipulation, machinery noise as atmosphere, and a persistent threat that makes every hallway re-traversal tense.

videos.title: Phasmophobia Gameplay No Commentary (4K/60fps)
videos.author: SHN Survival Horror Network
videos.why: Environmental/ghost horror built on lighting, darkness, and tool-based investigation. Lesson: strong atmosphere from darkness contrast and believable locations on a modest budget; avoid over-lighting every room.

videos.title: Making Counter Strike in JavaScript because why not
videos.author: iercan
videos.why: Devlog by the author of the enari-engine reference repo: a real FPS built in Three.js (movement, shooting, level). Primary technical reference for how to structure a Three.js first-person game at our scale.
